mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% m/m over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annualized) signals reduced industrial output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during the slowdown regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5% (annualized) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicate strong residential construction, supporting economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
